construction: Real recorded utterances, capped at eight seconds; 0.6-second inserted gaps. Returning speakers use different utterances. No oracle count reaches inference.
attribution: LibriSpeech: Vassil Panayotov, Guoguo Chen, Daniel Povey and Sanjeev Khudanpur; speech derived from LibriVox audiobooks.
reference_usage: Expected identity/count/time intervals were used only for post-inference assessment, never passed to diarization or language models.
limitations: Read English speech, not natural meetings or Greek speech.
Source-clip interiors include natural pauses; metrics are controlled-fixture indicators, not DER.
Short-turn and overlap stress cases do not establish supported overlap accuracy.
